method: Text-only research: no images were saved or embedded. Hosts were unreachable by the fetch tool from this container, so features come from web search results (news, API docs listings, wiki snippets) and prior knowledge; site status lines say how sure each is. Limits (file size, bump limit) vary by board and change; check the board's rules page before copying a number.

union_gaps: Safety first, before anything else: report button with categories, a moderator queue, delete/ban tools, rate limits/cooldowns and a captcha-free spam check, and rules shown before posting (4chan, every board); Verse must not accept or show uploaded pictures without its existing image refusal rules
Boards list -> board catalog grid -> thread view, with bump order, bump/image limits and old threads pruning off (4chan, 8chan.moe, 2chan, all vichan/LynxChan boards)
Anonymous post form: name optional, subject, comment, sage, spoiler, delete-own-post password (4chan, all)
Reply links >>123 with hover preview and backlinks, (OP)/(You) markers, cross-board links (4chan, all)
Catalog with sort (bump, last reply, created, replies) and search (4chan, LynxChan boards)
Thread watcher and auto-updating threads with new-reply counts; quick reply box (4chan native extension, mobile apps)
Tripcodes / per-thread poster IDs / daily IDs for identity without accounts (4chan, 5ch, 2chan)
Archive of fallen threads with search (4chan archive.html + 4plebs/desuarchive, 5ch past logs)
Read-only JSON API (4chan a.4cdn.org, LynxChan, vichan)
Hide/filter posts and threads by words (4chan extension, 5ch NG lists, apps)
Overboard: all boards' new threads in one feed (8chan.moe, LynxChan boards)
Reader reactions: soudane +1 and vote-to-hide (2chan), up/down votes (ylilauta)
User-created boards with owner moderation (8chan.moe, endchan, 8kun)
Text-only textboard mode with 1000-post threads and part-N continuation (5ch, open2ch, world2ch, textboard.org)
Paid pass to skip captcha (4chan Pass, 5ch Ronin, ylilauta Gold) - money: owner decides
